制服: 這是一台 DX 型資料匣擷取裝置，用來取出資料匣，目前裝著一個資料匣。

uniform: The slot appears to be about the size of a data cartridge. It is currently vacant.
制服: 這個插槽看起來剛好是資料匣的大小，目前是空的。

uniform: The alien observes his handiwork briefly, then leaves.
制服: 那名外星人打量了一下自己的傑作，接著就離開了。

uniform: This is one of the many hallways in the Arcada.
制服: 這是阿寇達號裡眾多走廊的其中一條。

uniform: You recognize this as your sanitation supply closet. You have spent many hours sleeping in it.
制服: 你認得這是你的清潔用品儲藏室，你在裡面睡掉了不少時間。

uniform: You have just stumbled into a small, dark, and very cluttered utility closet.  Many things fall, most of them landing on you. Doesn't say much for your cleaning prowess.
制服: 你一頭撞進一間又小又暗、亂七八糟的雜物間，一堆東西掉了下來，大半都砸在你身上。看來你的清潔功力也不怎麼樣。

uniform: You can't see anything in here because it is dark.
制服: 這裡一片漆黑，你什麼都看不見。

uniform: This is an elevator to one of the lower levels.
制服: 這是一部通往下層樓的電梯。

uniform: Is it shipping yet? I want this thing shipping yesterday. I thought you said the graphics would be done last week?
制服: 「東西出貨了沒？我恨不得它昨天就出貨。你不是說美術上星期就會弄完了嗎？」

uniform: The doors here are not particularly interesting.
制服: 這裡的門沒什麼特別的。

uniform: This is another one of your non-functional crewmates. It's a grisly sight.
制服: 這又是一位「故障」的組員，畫面實在慘不忍睹。

uniform: A quick search of the body turns up nothing.
制服: 你很快搜了一下屍體，什麼都沒找到。

uniform: That can't be done here.
制服: 這裡辦不到。

uniform: One can only wonder what your purpose for this action is. You can't undress the body. Allow him one last bit of dignity.
制服: 真不知道你在打什麼主意。你不能剝掉他的衣服，好歹留給他最後一點尊嚴吧。

uniform: Dave?  Dave's not here!
制服: 戴夫？戴夫不在這裡啦！

uniform: That is not seen easily from here.
制服: 從這裡看不太清楚。

uniform: Looking into the closet you see nothing but darkness.
制服: 你往儲藏室裡看去，只看到一片漆黑。

uniform: The door is closed, fool!
制服: 門是關著的啦，笨蛋！

uniform: This is the closed door to the closet you napped in.
制服: 這是你平常打盹的儲藏室的門，現在是關著的。

uniform: It looks dark in there.
制服: 裡面看起來黑漆漆的。

uniform: This door leads to the Data Archive.
制服: 這扇門通往資料庫。

uniform: You are in one of the Arcada's hallways near an elevator.
制服: 你正站在阿寇達號的一條走廊上，旁邊就是電梯。

uniform: This is an elevator to another level of the ship.
制服: 這是通往船艦其他樓層的電梯。

uniform: You search the body of your crewmate and find. . .
制服: 你搜索你組員的屍體，找到……

uniform: You take the keycard.
制服: 你拿走了磁卡。

uniform: You already have it.
制服: 你已經拿到了。

uniform: It appears to be one of your crewmates.  He is nonfunctional.
制服: 看來是你的一位組員，他已經「故障」了。

uniform: You have added to your pocket lint collection. How proud you must be.
制服: 你的口袋棉絮收藏又添了一件，你一定超驕傲的吧。

uniform: That can't be done from where you are standing.
制服: 你站在這個位置辦不到。

uniform: Unable to be tricked, you cleverly deduce that there are, indeed, walls in here. They are just your run-of-the-mill spacecraft interior walls.
制服: 你才不會被騙，很聰明地推斷出這裡真的有牆壁。就是那種再普通不過的太空船內牆。

uniform: Don't bother. Nothing of interest there.
制服: 別費心了，那裡沒什麼好看的。

uniform: You can see no elevator where you are.
制服: 你這個位置看不到電梯。

uniform: a keycard.
制服: 一張磁卡。

uniform: Nothing.
制服: 什麼都沒有。

uniform: This another hallway aboard the Arcada. There is an elevator door nearby.
制服: 這是阿寇達號上的另一條走廊，附近有一扇電梯門。

uniform: Sorry, due to your low security clearance you are not allowed access to this area.
制服: 抱歉，你的安全許可等級太低，不能進入這個區域。

uniform: This is an elevator to one of the other levels of the Arcada.
制服: 這是通往阿寇達號其他樓層的電梯。

uniform: That cannot be done from here.
制服: 在這裡辦不到。

uniform: There is no situation which calls for that action now.
制服: 現在沒有需要做那件事的情況。

uniform: The door is quite heavy and impossible for you to open. Your classification does not permit it.
制服: 這扇門相當沉重，你根本打不開。你的權限等級不允許。

uniform: A cursory glance indicates that this is a dead lab technician.
制服: 隨便一瞄就知道，這是一名死掉的實驗室技術員。

uniform: Your search of the body reveals nothing.
制服: 你搜遍屍體，什麼都沒找到。

uniform: This appears to be a non-breathing research scientist.
制服: 看起來是一名已經沒有呼吸的研究科學家。

uniform: Good grief, man! You are a bit twisted, I must say.?
制服: 天啊，老兄！我得說你這人還真有點變態。

uniform: There is not much left of the door. Someone has blown it away.
制服: 這扇門幾乎沒剩下什麼了，看來有人把它炸飛了。

uniform: You see another boring door.
制服: 你看到又一扇無聊的門。

uniform: Are you serious?
制服: 你是認真的嗎？

uniform: You are too far away to get a good look.
制服: 你離太遠了，看不清楚。

uniform: This is a section of one of the lower levels of Arcada.
制服: 這裡是阿寇達號下層的一部分。

uniform: The elevator leads to one of the upper levels.
制服: 這座電梯通往上面的某個樓層。

uniform: You see a body here. It is a formerly live crewmate.
制服: 你看到這裡有具屍體，曾經是一名活生生的組員。

uniform: Your search of the laser-riddled corpse reveals. . .
制服: 你搜索這具佈滿雷射傷痕的屍體，發現……

uniform: That can't be accomplished from here.
制服: 在這裡辦不到。

uniform: nothing.
制服: 什麼也沒有。

uniform: Taken.
制服: 拿走了。

uniform: Nothing interesting is to be seen there.
制服: 那裡沒什麼特別好看的。

uniform: It is a device designed to assist you in adjusting to a change in elevation.
制服: 這玩意兒的設計是用來幫你應付高度上的變化。

uniform: You are in the central control area of the Arcada. The reactor domes pulsate irregularly, as if they had been tampered with. This does not look good. Through the window just above the control console, you can see down into the vehicle bay below.
制服: 你正站在阿寇達號的中央控制區。反應爐的圓頂脈動得毫無規律，好像被人動過手腳，這下情況不妙。從控制台正上方的窗戶望出去，可以看到下方的載具艙。

uniform: This panel consists of status indicators which don't mean diddly to you.
制服: 這面板上全是狀態指示燈，對你來說根本有看沒有懂。

uniform: On the console by the window are two buttons marked "OPEN BAY DOOR" and "CLOSE BAY DOOR".
制服: 窗邊控制台上有兩個按鈕，分別寫著「打開艙門」和「關閉艙門」。

uniform: You can't see it from here.
制服: 這裡看不到那東西。

uniform: You search the damaged body of your fellow crewman. You get too close a glimpse of the injury. In the pockets you find...
制服: 你搜索同僚那具殘破的遺體，那傷口的畫面看得有點太清楚了。口袋裡你找到……

uniform: You don't see that here.
制服: 這裡沒看到那東西。

uniform: Looking through the window you can see down into the vehicle bay.
制服: 從窗戶望下去，可以看到載具艙。

uniform: Looking through the window you can see down into the vehicle bay. The rather massive bay doors are open.
制服: 從窗戶望下去，可以看到載具艙，那扇碩大的艙門是開著的。

uniform: Here lies another heap of fried humanity. The attackers have proven to be very thorough thus far.  There's something to be said for not being the hero type, you rationalize.
制服: 這裡又躺著一具烤焦的人肉。看來攻擊者做事相當徹底。你心裡想，不當英雄好像也不是壞事。

uniform: Nothing happens.
制服: 什麼事都沒發生。

uniform: Nothing of interest there.
制服: 那裡沒什麼好留意的。

uniform: The bay door can't be closed while the pod is up.
制服: 逃生艙的平台還升著的時候，艙門沒辦法關上。

uniform: Your limited view shows that there is a large vehicle bay below.
制服: 你視野有限，只能看出下面是個很大的載具艙。

uniform: On the floor are three domes, covering closed access tubes, and one badly damaged body.
制服: 地上有三個圓頂，蓋著關閉的通道管，還有一具傷得很重的遺體。

uniform: The domes cover access tubes to the Arcada's power plant. They are bolted closed since they seldom require maintenance.
制服: 這些圓頂蓋住通往阿寇達號動力廠的通道管，因為很少需要維修，都用螺栓鎖死了。

uniform: This is one of the mid-level decks of the Arcada
制服: 這裡是阿寇達號的中層甲板之一

uniform: The elevator goes to another level. You have never used it due to its restricted access status.
制服: 這座電梯通往另一層樓。因為權限受限，你從來沒用過它。

uniform: You slide the keycard into its slot. You hear an audible click. You take the keycard back.
制服: 你把磁卡插進插槽，聽到「喀」一聲，接著把磁卡收回來。

uniform: You are too far away.
制服: 你離得太遠了。

uniform: You don't have that.
制服: 你沒有那東西。

uniform: The walls are all nondescript except for a keycard unit near the elevator. It controls access to the level below.
制服: 牆壁上沒什麼特別的，只有電梯旁一個磁卡讀取器，控制通往樓下的權限。

uniform: One of your crewmates lies at your feet. He is non-functional.
制服: 你的一位同僚倒在你腳邊，已經不能動了。

uniform: %w1 %w2? I'm sorry, %s1. You can't do that. I question your mental fitness.
制服: %w1 %w2？抱歉，%s1，你辦不到那件事。我開始懷疑你的精神狀態了。

uniform: You search the corpse and turn up. . .
制服: 你搜索屍體，翻出了……

uniform: The keycard unit is a small, sturdy box with a slot. Just above it is a display light which is not currently on.
制服: 磁卡讀取器是個堅固的小盒子，上面有個插槽。正上方有個顯示燈，目前沒亮。

uniform: The keycard unit is a small, sturdy box with a slot. Just above it is a display light which is currently on.
制服: 磁卡讀取器是個堅固的小盒子，上面有個插槽。正上方有個顯示燈，目前是亮著的。

uniform: There is no keycard to get.
制服: 沒有磁卡可以拿。

uniform: Alas, it does not open. You have adorned the door with a small circle of nose grease. Were you Karl Malden, it could have gotten ugly.
制服: 唉，門還是沒開。你只在門上印了一圈鼻油印。要是你的鼻子像 Karl Malden 那麼大，情況恐怕會很難看。

uniform: This is the cavernous Vehicle Bay.
制服: 這裡是空曠的載具艙。

uniform: This is one of the Arcada's escape pods. You vaguely remember receiving some orientation on these when you joined the crew.
制服: 這是阿寇達號的逃生艙之一。你隱約記得剛加入船員時，有接受過這方面的講習。

uniform: Oops!      Forgot my suit.
制服: 糟了！      忘記穿太空裝了。

uniform: In the middle of the vehicle bay is a deep cargo shaft.
制服: 載具艙中央有一道很深的貨運豎井。

uniform: Sorry, %s1.  You can't enter the Escape Pod when the Vehicle Bay doors are closed.
制服: 抱歉，%s1，載具艙門關著的時候，你沒辦法進入逃生艙。

uniform: Looking at the console you see a button marked "Platform". There are also some gauges which don't interest you.
制服: 看著控制台，你看到一個寫著「平台」的按鈕，還有一些你沒興趣理會的儀表。

uniform: The Vehicle Bay Door is quite large.
制服: 載具艙門相當龐大。

uniform: The walls prove to be uninteresting.
制服: 牆壁沒什麼好看的。

uniform: The massive bay doors are tightly sealed.
制服: 這幾扇巨大的艙門封得死死的。

uniform: Beyond the yawning doors lies the serenity of deep space.
制服: 敞開的艙門外，是一片深邃太空的寧靜。

uniform: You see nothing special down there.
制服: 你在下面沒看到什麼特別的東西。

uniform: It is dark down in the shaft but you can make out the silhouette of one of the Arcada's escape pods on a platform below.
制服: 豎井裡面很暗，但你能看出下面平台上有一艘阿寇達號逃生艙的輪廓。

uniform: You cannot perform that act from here.
制服: 你在這裡沒辦法做那件事。

uniform: There is nothing like that in sight.
制服: 眼前沒有那種東西。

uniform: No can do, bud.
制服: 辦不到啦，老兄。

uniform: For safety reasons the platform will not function with the bay doors closed.
制服: 基於安全考量，艙門關著的時候平台沒辦法運作。

uniform: The bay door is open. The airlock door opens automatically.
制服: 艙門是開著的，氣密艙門會自動開啟。

uniform: The bay door is not opened from this room. The airlock door opens automatically.
制服: 艙門沒辦法從這個房間打開，氣密艙門會自動開啟。

uniform: There sure are a lot of them.
制服: 還真是不少呢。

uniform: You see stars to infinity.
制服: 你看到滿天繁星，一望無際。

uniform: The pod door is already open.
制服: 逃生艙門已經開著了。

uniform: The escape pod moves slowly out
制服: 逃生艙緩緩滑了出去，

uniform: of the vehicle bay and into space.
制服: 離開了載具艙，飛向太空。

uniform: There is now an escape pod here.
制服: 這裡現在有一個逃生艙。

uniform: There is no longer an escape pod here.
制服: 這裡已經沒有逃生艙了。

uniform: You see a button marked "Platform".
制服: 你看到一個寫著「平台」的按鈕。

uniform: Congratulations, %s1.  You have found your way off the Arcada and escaped obvious danger.  Unfortunately, you will never be seen or heard from again as you float gracefully through the heavens for eternity.
制服: 恭喜你，%s1。你順利逃出了阿寇達號，也躲過了明顯的危險——只不過，你就這樣優雅地漂浮在宇宙裡直到永遠，再也沒人會看到你、聽到你的消息了。

uniform: You peer in through the open door but are unable to make out any detail.
制服: 你透過開著的門往裡瞧，但看不清楚裡面的細節。

uniform: This is the Flight Prep room of the Arcada. As you can see, there is a sign on the back wall as well as two closet doors and two buttons.
制服: 這裡是阿寇達號的飛行準備室。你可以看到後牆上有個標示牌，還有兩扇衣櫃門和兩個按鈕。

uniform: The walls look pretty much the same as the others. There is a sign on the back wall. Beneath that is a right button and a left button.
制服: 這裡的牆壁跟其他地方差不多。後牆上有個標示牌，下面是左右兩個按鈕。

uniform: This is the inside airlock door.
制服: 這是氣密艙的內側艙門。

uniform: That is not here to be seen.
制服: 這裡看不到那東西。

uniform: The closet appears to be empty.
制服: 衣櫃看起來是空的。

uniform: This is the elevator you came into this room from.
制服: 這是你進到這房間時搭的電梯。

uniform: There are two buttons here, a left button and a right button.
制服: 這裡有兩個按鈕，一個在左邊，一個在右邊。

uniform: There are two doors here which are controlled by buttons.
制服: 這裡有兩扇門，都是靠按鈕控制的。

uniform: The console is adorned with many status indicators. One button on the right is marked "Airlock".
制服: 控制台上滿是狀態指示燈，右邊有個按鈕寫著「氣密艙」。

uniform: This is a standard issue flight suit designed to protect the wearer from the unique conditions of space travel.
制服: 這是制式配發的太空裝，設計來保護穿戴者應付太空旅行的特殊環境。

uniform: On the floor of the closet sits some sort of gadget. It looks electronic.
制服: 衣櫃地板上放著某種小裝置，看起來像是電子產品。

uniform: Your sight isn't what it once was. Maybe mom and dad weren't kidding. Anyway, you'll have to get closer.
制服: 你的視力大不如前了。搞不好爸媽當年說的是真的。總之，你得再靠近一點看。

uniform: The sign on the wall suggests that the bay doors are not currently open.
制服: 牆上的標示牌顯示，艙門目前沒有開著。

uniform: The sign on the wall warns that the bay doors are currently open.
制服: 牆上的標示牌警告，艙門目前是開著的。

uniform: You see a flight suit hanging in the closet.
制服: 你看到衣櫃裡掛著一套太空裝。

uniform: There is a closed closet door here.
制服: 這裡有一扇關著的衣櫃門。

uniform: It looks like an electrical gadget of some sort.
制服: 看起來像是某種電子小裝置。

uniform: You are not close enough.
制服: 你離得不夠近。

uniform: The closet is not open.
制服: 衣櫃還沒打開。

uniform: You won't be needing that suit anymore.
制服: 你已經用不到那套裝備了。

uniform: There is nothing here to get.
制服: 這裡沒有東西可以拿。

uniform: That can't be done from here.
制服: 在這裡沒辦法做那件事。

uniform: There are no buttons here.
制服: 這裡沒有按鈕。

uniform: Nothing done.
制服: 什麼都沒做成。

uniform: The door is open and there is no need to close it. Pressing matters await.
制服: 門已經開著，不用關。還有更要緊的事等著你。

uniform: You already have it on.
制服: 你已經穿上了。

uniform: The doors are controlled by buttons. You must push the appropriate one.
制服: 這些門是靠按鈕控制的，你得按對按鈕才行。

uniform: The elevator door opens and closes automatically.
制服: 電梯門會自動開關。

uniform: You are not close enough to get a good look.
制服: 你離得不夠近，看不清楚。

uniform: Your old uniform hangs in the closet.
制服: 你的舊制服掛在衣櫃裡。

uniform: The elevator door opens automatically and the others open by pushing buttons.
制服: 電梯門會自動開，其他門則要按按鈕才會開。

uniform: This is not a good place to do that from.
制服: 這裡不是做那件事的好地方。

uniform: You'll need to get closer to see that.
制服: 你得靠近一點才看得到。

uniform: You'll have to be more specific. The right closet or the left closet?
制服: 講清楚一點。是右邊的衣櫃，還是左邊的？

uniform: You need to get closer.
制服: 你得靠近一點。

uniform: You'll have to be more specific about which button you wish to choose.
制服: 講清楚一點，你要選哪個按鈕？

uniform: You see one button marked "Airlock".
制服: 你看到一個寫著「氣密艙」的按鈕。

uniform: Your old uniform hangs limply in the closet.
制服: 你的舊制服軟趴趴地掛在衣櫃裡。

uniform: You are sitting in the pilot seat of the escape pod facing toward the window. There is a dark console before you and seat belt straps at your side. Confused as to what you should do, you wish you would have paid more attention during crew orientation.
制服: 你坐在逃生艙的駕駛座上，面朝窗戶。眼前是一個暗著的控制台，身旁則是安全帶。你一頭霧水，不知道該做什麼，真希望當初船員講習有認真聽。

uniform: Your effort to power-down the pod was wisely overridden by the on-board computer.
制服: 你想關掉逃生艙電源，還好被船上電腦明智地擋了下來。

uniform: The screen is dark.
制服: 螢幕是暗的。

uniform: Escape Pod Systems Activated
制服: 逃生艙系統已啟動

uniform: Ready For Instructions
制服: 等待指令輸入

uniform: Emergency Program Initiated
制服: 緊急程式已啟動

uniform: Pull Throttle To Execute
制服: 拉下節流閥以執行

uniform: Launch Sequence

制服: 上面明明寫著「請勿觸碰」，我警告過你了！

uniform: Please buckle your seat belt first.

uniform: The monitor flashes. You study it to see what new information is being displayed.

uniform: It sure looks deep.

uniform: You have already done that.
制服: 你已經做過那件事了。

uniform: There are three buttons here. They are marked "AutoNav", "Power", and "Don't Touch".
制服: 這裡有三個按鈕，分別標著「自動導航」、「電源」和「請勿觸碰」。

uniform: There are some lights on. They indicate (when lit) that all pod systems are functioning normally.
制服: 有幾盞燈亮著，這些燈亮起時，表示逃生艙所有系統運作正常。

uniform: The lights on the console are currently not on.
制服: 控制台上的燈目前沒有亮。

uniform: That act has already been performed.
制服: 這件事你已經做過了。

uniform: Are you crazy? It seems quite obvious that you don't know what you are doing, you daft imp.
制服: 你瘋了嗎？很明顯你根本不知道自己在幹嘛，你這個蠢蛋。

uniform: You'll have to be more specific. The autonav button or the power button?

uniform: Hey! What are you doing? Don't mess with the throttle while in flight! You have enough problems already. Why don't you spend your time thinking about how you're going to handle them?
制服: 欸！你在幹嘛？飛行途中不要亂動節流閥！你麻煩已經夠多了，怎麼不花點時間想想要怎麼解決？

uniform: Your door is ajar.
制服: 你的艙門沒關緊。

uniform: I'm sorry, Dave. I'm afraid I can't do that.
制服: 很抱歉，戴夫，恐怕我沒辦法這麼做。

uniform: The throttle is of the usual "T"-shaped variety.

uniform: You can't. The door is closed.
制服: 不行，門是關著的。

uniform: You can't. You are buckled into your seat.
制服: 不行，你的安全帶還扣著。

uniform: You see nothing of interest.
制服: 你沒看到什麼特別的東西。

uniform: The throttle is currently in a position that prevents you from doing that.
制服: 節流閥目前的位置讓你沒辦法這麼做。

uniform: Don't worry. Aside from a stray Sarien attack, this is a low crime area.
制服: 別擔心，除了偶爾有沙利安人來亂之外，這一帶治安算不錯。

uniform: The throttle is already in that position.
制服: 節流閥已經在那個位置了。

uniform: The door is small and uninteresting. It is presently closed.
制服: 這扇門又小又平凡，目前是關著的。

uniform: The door is small and uninteresting. It is presently open.
制服: 這扇門又小又平凡，目前是開著的。

uniform: All systems are GO
制服: 所有系統一切正常

uniform: They're just your typical passenger restraint devices.
制服: 這只是一般的乘客安全束帶裝置。

uniform: The throttle is back as far as it will go.
制服: 節流閥已經拉到底了。

uniform: You should specify which button you would like to push.
制服: 你該說清楚想按哪個按鈕。

uniform: Please remain seated and keep seat belt buckled while vehicle is in motion.
制服: 載具行進中請坐好，並繫緊安全帶。

uniform: . . . .WARNING. . . .
Self-Destruct Mechanism Has Been Armed!
制服: 自毀裝置已啟動！

uniform: Evacuate Ship Immediately!
制服: 立刻棄船逃生！

uniform: !! THIS IS NOT A TEST !!
制服: ！！這不是演習！！

uniform: This is the Star Generator development laboratory.  Due to your incredibly low security clearance you have never been allowed access to this room.
制服: 這裡是星辰產生器的研發實驗室。以你低到不行的安全權限，本來根本不可能踏進這間房間。

uniform: Through the observation window you can see to infinity.
制服: 透過觀測窗，你可以看到無窮無盡的遠方。

uniform: Looking at the console you see many displays and instruments which make no sense to you.  There is a flashing light near a screen in the center.
制服: 你看著控制台，上面一堆顯示器和儀器你完全看不懂。中央的螢幕附近有一盞燈在閃。

uniform: There is an empty pedestal here. It looks like it is used to hold some large object, maybe the Star Generator.
制服: 這裡有一座空的底座，看起來是用來放置某個大型物體的，也許就是星辰產生器。

uniform: The floor is normal except for two dead bodies and a pedestal in the middle.
制服: 地板看起來沒什麼異狀，只是中間躺著兩具屍體，還有一座底座。

uniform: The back wall is barren. The others, as you can see, are actually large windows allowing you an unrestricted view of space.
制服: 後牆光禿禿的什麼都沒有，其他牆面你也看得出來，其實都是大片窗戶，讓你能毫無阻隔地看到外太空。

uniform: Hanging from the ceiling is a large device which apparently helped support the item which was mounted on the pedestal below.
制服: 天花板上垂掛著一具大型裝置，看起來是用來支撐底下底座上那件物品的。

uniform: That can't be done at this location.
制服: 這個地方沒辦法這麼做。

uniform: The sheer vastness of space never ceases to amaze you.
制服: 太空浩瀚無垠的景象，總是讓你嘆為觀止。

uniform: Gazing out at the stars reminds you of how far you are from home.
制服: 望著滿天星斗，讓你想起自己離家有多遠。

uniform: Peering through the large observation windows you take in the immense panorama of space and stars.
制服: 你透過大片觀測窗，把浩瀚的星空盡收眼底。

uniform: Your mind is boggled in attempting to understand the function of the various buttons, switches, lights, and displays. It appears the board is not operating.
制服: 你想搞懂這些按鈕、開關、燈號和顯示器到底是幹嘛用的，但完全一頭霧水。看起來這片面板根本沒在運作。

uniform: This console shows the only signs of life. One red light shines from the the upper-left corner of a glowing monitor.
制服: 這座控制台是唯一還有動靜的地方，一盞紅燈從發著光的螢幕左上角亮著。

uniform: That console could be better viewed from a closer vantage point.
制服: 這座控制台再靠近一點看會更清楚。

uniform: There are many buttons here. Messing with them will not help anything.
制服: 這裡有一堆按鈕，亂按也不會有什麼幫助。

uniform: The lights are all out except for one on the other console.
制服: 燈全滅了，只剩另一座控制台上還有一盞亮著。

uniform: One light glows red indicating that the monitor power is on.
制服: 有一盞紅燈亮著，表示螢幕的電源是開著的。

uniform: There is nothing to see here.
制服: 這裡沒什麼好看的。

uniform: That can not be seen from here.
制服: 從這裡看不到那個。

uniform: You see sprawled at your feet the lifeless body of another crew member.
制服: 你腳邊倒著另一名船員的屍體。

uniform: Yet another body lies motionless.
制服: 又是一具動也不動的屍體。

uniform: The reward for your search is. . .
制服: 你搜索的收穫是……

uniform: There is no Star Generator here to look at.
制服: 這裡沒有星辰產生器可以看。

uniform: Congratulations! You have narrowly escaped an explosive death! Don't start patting yourself on the back just yet, though. You are now traveling aimlessly through the cosmos.
制服: 恭喜！你千鈞一髮逃過一場爆炸死亡！不過先別急著自誇，你現在正在宇宙中漫無目的地漂流。

uniform: The Autonav system has locked onto the small planet of Kerona and the pod has begun its approach. Nothing to do now but hang on!
制服: 自動導航系統已經鎖定柯羅娜星這顆小行星，逃生艙已經開始接近。現在你只能抓緊坐穩！

uniform: Well done, %s1! You've managed to overcome the elements of Kerona, from endless deserts and spider droids to obnoxious salesmen and bad booze. Yes, the sand in your boots shall forever serve as a reminder of this forsaken planet. You should feel proud. But now, destiny awaits with an even greater challenge.
制服: 做得好，%s1！你撐過了柯羅娜星的種種考驗——無盡的沙漠、蜘蛛機器人、討人厭的推銷員，還有難喝到爆的酒。沒錯，靴子裡的沙子會永遠提醒你這顆被遺忘的星球。你應該為自己感到驕傲。但現在，命運正等著你迎接更大的挑戰。

uniform: You are inside the escape pod. It appears that the more fragile devices were damaged severely by the impact of landing.
制服: 你在逃生艙裡，看起來比較脆弱的裝置在降落撞擊中都嚴重損壞了。

uniform: Through the window you see a vast wasteland composed of sand.
制服: 透過窗戶，你看到一片由沙子構成的遼闊荒地。

uniform: The console consists of a screen, pod status indicators, a throttle, and some buttons.  The buttons are marked "AutoNav" and "Power".
制服: 控制台上有一個螢幕、逃生艙狀態指示燈、一根節流閥，還有幾個按鈕。按鈕分別標著「自動導航」和「電源」。

uniform: Pushing the AutoNav button has no effect.
制服: 按下自動導航按鈕沒有任何反應。

uniform: The throttle seems to be jammed.  It won't budge.
制服: 節流閥好像卡住了，動也不動。

uniform: The screen is dark, not to mention cracked.
制服: 螢幕一片漆黑，而且還裂了。

uniform: Pushing the Power button has no effect.
制服: 按下電源按鈕沒有任何反應。

uniform: You are inside the escape pod. It appears that the more fragile devices were damaged severely by the impact of landing.  Got any bright ideas, Edison?
制服: 你在逃生艙裡，看起來比較脆弱的裝置在降落撞擊中都嚴重損壞了。有什麼好點子嗎，愛迪生？

uniform: You are unable to leave with your seat belt on.
制服: 安全帶還扣著，你沒辦法離開。

uniform: Done
制服: 完成

uniform: That has already been done.
制服: 這件事已經做過了。

uniform: You can fix nothing here.
制服: 這裡沒有東西可以修。

uniform: Neither this nor anything else on the console works.
制服: 這個和控制台上其他東西都沒有用。

uniform: There are three buttons here. They are marked "AutoNav", "Power", and "Don't Press".
制服: 這裡有三個按鈕，分別標著「自動導航」、「電源」和「請勿按下」。

uniform: The door has been permanently opened by the impact of landing.
制服: 這扇門在降落撞擊中被撞得永久打開了。

uniform: A survival kit has broken loose from someplace.
制服: 一個求生包不知道從哪裡鬆脫，掉了下來。

uniform: There is nothing under the seat.
制服: 座位底下什麼都沒有。

uniform: After a skull-jarring landing, you peer through the shattered viewing port out onto the desert landscape. A feeling of utter desolation settles in. You`re in a fine mess now, %s1.
制服: 經過一陣天旋地轉的硬著陸後，你從破裂的觀測窗望向外面的沙漠景色，一股徹底的荒涼感湧上心頭。你這下麻煩大了，%s1。

uniform: No way.
制服: 沒門。

uniform: You are high atop a rocky plateau. The desert below seems to stretch to infinity.
制服: 你站在一座岩石高原頂端，下方的沙漠彷彿無邊無際地延伸出去。

uniform: It is merely a spire of rock which has managed to defy the elements.
制服: 這只是一根撐過風吹日曬的岩石尖塔。

uniform: You are near the base of a plateau. It is a rather bleak environment.
制服: 你在一座高原的底部附近，這裡的環境相當荒涼。

uniform: You are high atop a rocky plateau near two halves of an arch. The desert below seems to stretch to infinity.
制服: 你站在一座岩石高原頂端，附近有一座斷成兩半的拱門，下方的沙漠彷彿無邊無際地延伸出去。

uniform: You are near the base of a plateau, upon which rests two large rocks. It is a rather bleak environment.
制服: 你在一座高原的底部附近，上頭擺著兩塊大石頭，這裡的環境相當荒涼。

uniform: You see a pair of oddly curved rock formations. They point at each other as if to form an arch.
制服: 你看到一對形狀怪異的彎曲岩層，彼此對望，彷彿要拼成一座拱門。

uniform: Near the base you notice some very small printing. If you're not mistaken the characters translate to "497 Quadgillion Served."
制服: 在底部你注意到幾個很小的印刷字。如果你沒看錯，這些字翻譯過來是「已服務 497 垓位顧客。」

uniform: From this distance it looks like an ordinary hole in the side of the cliff.  For a better look you will have to get closer.
制服: 從這個距離看，這只是懸崖側面一個普通的洞，想看清楚一點，你得靠近一些。

uniform: Whatever is in that hole just enjoyed lunch - on you.  This should teach you to be cautious when encountering alien holes.
制服: 不管那個洞裡是什麼東西，牠剛剛美美地吃了一頓——就是你，這下你該學乖了，遇到外星洞穴要小心一點。

uniform: You are atop the mesa. It is flat to the west.
制服: 你在台地頂端，西邊是一片平地。

uniform: You are at the west side of a cliff area.
制服: 你在懸崖區域的西側。

uniform: No good will come of that.
制服: 這麼做不會有好下場。

uniform: Looking at the cliff you notice a small hole
制服: 你看著懸崖，注意到一個小洞

uniform: It lands with a pleasing thud.
制服: 它「咚」一聲落地，聲音還挺讓人滿意的。

uniform: It was not known that you are a master of the rock! That was a fine effort.
制服: 沒想到你居然是丟石頭高手！這一手漂亮。

uniform: It looks a lot like spinach.
制服: 這看起來很像菠菜。

uniform: You tear off a piece of the plant.
制服: 你扯下一片植物。

uniform: The Health Minister has determined that smoking is hazardous to your health.
制服: 衛生署長已經證實，吸菸有害健康。

uniform: You take a whiff of the plant and find it to be a regrettable experience.
制服: 你聞了聞這株植物，這下可讓你後悔了。

uniform: That is unreachable from here.
制服: 從這裡搆不到那個。

uniform: You already have that.
制服: 你已經有那個了。

uniform: You are not near that.
制服: 你不在那附近。

uniform: You are in a unique area. There is a natural land bridge here as well as life in the form of plants.
制服: 你在一處特別的地方，這裡有一座天然的地橋，還長著一些植物。

uniform: There is a very large rock on the natural bridge.
制服: 天然地橋上有一塊很大的石頭。

uniform: On the ground rests a large boulder.
制服: 地上擺著一塊大石頭。

uniform: There are no rocks of note here.
制服: 這裡沒有什麼值得注意的石頭。

uniform: You are following a path on the side of a cliff. It is rather desolate here.
制服: 你沿著懸崖邊的小路前進，這裡相當荒涼。

uniform: You are in an area almost entirely surrounded by cliffs. A path winds its way along the sheer cliff to the left. It is not accessible from here.
制服: 你身處一處幾乎完全被懸崖包圍的地方。一條小路沿著左邊的峭壁蜿蜒而去，但從這裡走不過去。

uniform: You are in an area almost entirely surrounded by cliffs. A path winds its way along the sheer cliff to the left. It is not accessible from here. There is a cave to the right.
制服: 你身處一處幾乎完全被懸崖包圍的地方。一條小路沿著左邊的峭壁蜿蜒而去，但從這裡走不過去。右邊有一個洞穴。

uniform: A path winds its way along the sheer cliff to the left. It is not accessible from here.
制服: 一條小路沿著左邊的峭壁蜿蜒而去，但從這裡走不過去。

uniform: You are walking along a path high above the ground.
制服: 你正走在一條高懸於地面之上的小路。

uniform: You are at the southwest edge of a mesa. It is very desolate here.
制服: 你在台地的西南邊緣，這裡非常荒涼。

uniform: You are in a desert cliff area. There is a natural land bridge in the distance.
制服: 你在沙漠懸崖區，遠處有一座天然地橋。

uniform: It looks a lot like spinach.
制服: 這看起來很像菠菜。

uniform: You plant your teeth in the strange plant and take a large bite, only to find it tastes exquisitely bad. If you had your choice, you would choose any form of death over a meal of this.
制服: 你一口咬進這株奇怪的植物，狠狠地咬了一大口，結果發現味道糟糕到極點。如果讓你選，你寧願死也不要再吃一口這種東西。

uniform: You are in a desert cliff area.
制服: 你在沙漠懸崖區。

uniform: Fortunately for you, the path here is not far above the ground. Your suffering is limited to a dull pain in the hindquarters.
制服: 算你走運，這裡的小路離地面不高，你頂多只是屁股隱隱作痛。

uniform: The cave interior now features a lovely new Jagged Metal/Liberated Entrails motif. The stench? Whew! Not even an all-text adventure would attempt that description.
制服: 洞穴內部現在多了一種嶄新的「鋸齒鐵片∕內臟四散」風格裝潢。至於那股臭味？呼！就連純文字冒險遊戲也不敢形容那有多恐怖。

uniform: What have we here?
制服: 「這裡有什麼好東西？」

uniform: You reach down and take the Orat part in your hand. Some of it oozes to fill the space between your fingers.
制服: 你伸手拿起那塊歐拉特的殘骸，有些黏液滲出來，填滿了你指縫間的空隙。

uniform: You'd want MORE of THAT? You are truly twisted. Seek a physician when you hit town.
制服: 你還想要更多？你真的有夠變態，等你到鎮上記得去看醫生。

uniform: You're going to have to go one-on-one against Orat for something like that?
制服: 你打算就這樣跟歐拉特單挑？

uniform: You've just been molecularly re-distributed by the spider droid. Tough luck, %s1.
制服: 你剛剛被蜘蛛機器人拆成分子重組了。運氣真背，%s1。

uniform: You are in the slimiest of caves. The odor in here is less than desirable.
制服: 你人在一個黏糊糊的洞穴裡，這裡的味道實在不怎麼樣。

uniform: The walls are solid rock.
制服: 牆壁是堅硬的岩石。

uniform: The walls are solid rock. You notice a fine spray of glistening, metallic jelly.
制服: 牆壁是堅硬的岩石。你注意到有一層閃著金屬光澤的黏液噴濺在上面。

uniform: It looks like the rest of the ground around here. The green spots indicate that there is a little moisture.
制服: 看起來跟這附近的地面沒兩樣，上面的綠色斑點顯示這裡有一點濕氣。

uniform: On the ground rests a gleaming chunk of Orat's anatomy.
制服: 地上躺著一小塊閃閃發亮的歐拉特殘骸。

uniform: It is very large and very hard.
制服: 它又大又硬。

uniform: Orat is huge and ugly. Of course, your opinion may differ depending on what part of the universe you come from. It should also be mentioned that he is quite mean.
制服: 歐拉特體型巨大又醜陋。當然啦，這要看你是從宇宙的哪個角落來的，看法可能不太一樣。另外要提醒你一下，牠脾氣壞得很。

uniform: You shiver at the sight of the spider droid with its spindly legs and cold metallic body. Its red scanner probing the terrain for anything that moves. Truly an icon of terror.
制服: 蜘蛛機器人細長的腿和冰冷的金屬軀體讓你不寒而慄。牠紅色的掃描器正在地形上搜尋任何會動的東西，簡直就是恐怖的化身。

uniform: You are unable to do that.
制服: 你辦不到。

uniform: You have trouble moving your own carcass around. You sure can't move something that weighs several times more than you.
制服: 你連自己這副身子都快搬不動了，更別說搬動比你重好幾倍的東西。

uniform: There is no need for you to do that.

uniform: The man is not interested in idle conversation. He's only interested in the skimmer.

uniform: The key is not in its hole.
制服: 鑰匙沒插在孔裡。

uniform: You are not in a position to do that.
制服: 你現在的位置做不了這件事。

uniform: You watch as the skimmer is driven away by its new owner.
制服: 你看著新主人把沙漠飛車開走了。

uniform: My, my. It would appear that your skimmer has become the property of another. I wonder who forgot to remove the key?
制服: 哎呀哎呀，看來你的沙漠飛車已經變成別人的財產了。真不知道是誰忘了把鑰匙拔起來呢？

uniform: It's not yours anymore. Leave it alone.
制服: 那已經不是你的了，別亂碰。

uniform: Wise up, %s1! You're already on it.
制服: 醒醒吧，%s1！你已經在上面了。

uniform: The ships are locked.
制服: 這些飛船都鎖住了。

uniform: Hey! I'll gladly take that crusty old skimmer off your hands. What do you think? Yes or No?
制服: 「嘿！你那台破舊的沙漠飛車，我很樂意幫你處理掉。如何？要還是不要？」

uniform: The guy (or whatever it is) is busy leaving.
制服: 那傢伙（或不管它是什麼東西）正忙著離開。

uniform: The skimmer is attempting to leave. Get out of the way, you geek!
制服: 沙漠飛車要開走了，讓開啦，你這呆子！

uniform: Do not remove the key while the skimmer is in motion.
制服: 沙漠飛車還在動的時候別把鑰匙拔掉。

uniform: %v124 buckazoids? I guess it's better than nothing. Here, keep five for yourself. I gotta admit you look like you need it. Well, gotta run. Later, pal.
制服: 「%v124 太空幣？總比沒有好吧。來，留五枚給你自己，說真的你看起來滿需要的。好啦，我得閃了，回頭見，老兄。」

uniform: Your newly acquired droid seems to have self-destructed. Hope it's under warranty.
制服: 你新買的機器人好像自爆了，希望它還在保固期內。

uniform: This is the back of the bar at the southeast end of Ulence Flats.
制服: 這裡是尤倫斯荒原東南端酒吧的後面。

uniform: There is some writing on it.
制服: 上面寫著一些字。

uniform: It appears to be in Sarien. You're a little rusty in your Sarien but it appears to say "Xenon Bites!"
制服: 看起來是沙利安文。你的沙利安語有點生疏，但大概看得出寫的是「氙星遜斃了！」

uniform: You're not close enough to see that clearly.
制服: 你離得不夠近，看不清楚。

uniform: There is a strange pile of very fine white powder here. It's origin puzzles you. It has a strange burnt smell to it.
制服: 這裡有一小堆奇怪的白色細粉，你猜不出它是哪來的，還帶著一股怪異的燒焦味。

uniform: I'm beginning to understand you a little better now. You snort some of the powder and feel a pain like that of a thousand krebble mites feasting on your nasal membranes.
制服: 你現在稍微懂它一點了。你吸了一點粉末，鼻腔立刻痛得像是有上千隻克瑞柏蟲在裡面開派對。

uniform: The extremely fine dust seeps between your fingers. There is no need for it anyway. Especially considering its origin.
制服: 這超細的粉末從你的指縫間流掉了。反正你也用不上，何況想到它的來源，還是算了吧。

uniform: You'd better not move if you want to remain alive.
制服: 想活命的話，最好別亂動。

uniform: The droid, while looking small is quite heavy and not moveable by you.
制服: 這機器人看起來小小一隻，其實重得很，你搬不動。

uniform: He just wants your buckazoids but will take your life if he has to.
制服: 他只想要你的太空幣，但必要的話他會要你的命。

uniform: You now have a throbbing appendage.
制服: 你現在有個部位在陣陣抽痛。

uniform: Hold it right there, pal! This is a stick-up! I'll just relieve you of your cash, thank you very much.
制服: 「站住別動，老兄！這是搶劫！你的錢，我就不客氣收下囉，謝啦。」

uniform: %v124 buckazoids? I guess it's better than nothing. Here, keep five for yourself. I gotta admit you look like you need it.
制服: 「%v124 太空幣？總比沒有好吧。來，留五枚給你自己，說真的你看起來滿需要的。」

uniform: Well, you've got to be leaving now. Go straight back the way you came in. Deviate from that path and you're Grell kibble!
制服: 「好了，你該滾了。原路給我直直走回去，敢亂繞路，你就等著變格瑞爾的飼料吧！」

uniform: I warned you, but, did you listen?
制服: 「我警告過你了，你有聽嗎？」

uniform: The mugger impresses upon you that he was quite serious.
制服: 那個搶匪讓你清楚感受到，他是玩真的。

uniform: The droid is beyond repair. Now you know why it was on sale.
制服: 這機器人已經修不好了，現在你知道它為什麼會特價出清了吧。

uniform: Well, there's a man with a good eye. This here is the keenest little scrambler in the hemisphere. Top of the line. Handles like a charm. Perfect for cruising the asteroid fields.
制服: 「唷，真有眼光啊。這台可是這半球裡數一數二犀利的飛船，頂級規格，操控起來順到不行，最適合在小行星帶裡巡航了。」

uniform: And she's got all the thrust a guy could need. I tell ya, she's an outright steal at 214 buckazoids.
制服: 「她的推力更是應有盡有。老實跟你說，214枚太空幣根本是白撿的價錢。」

uniform: With your 70 buckazoid credit that would come to. . .let's see. . .uhm. . 144 buckazoids.
制服: 「加上你的 70 太空幣抵用額度，那樣算下來……讓我看看……呃……是 144 太空幣。」

uniform: You need to be closer to the middle of the ladder to be able to climb it.
制服: 你得靠近梯子中間一點，才爬得上去。

uniform: You can't do that now.
制服: 你現在不能這麼做。

uniform: So what are ya trying to pull? If you don't have the cash, you can hit the road. Go on, get out of here. You're wasting my time!
制服: 「你到底想搞什麼把戲？沒錢就滾一邊去，走啦，別浪費我的時間！」

uniform: I tell ya, I think you've made a wise decision. She's a beauty. The keys are in her. If you have any problems, don't hesitate to come back and tell us about 'em.
制服: 「跟你說啦，我覺得你這決定很明智。這艘船漂亮得很，鑰匙就在裡面。有什麼問題儘管回來找我們說。」

uniform: We have a motto. You don't own it - You don't mess with it - You don't die!
制服: 「我們有一句座右銘：不是你的——別亂碰——不然會沒命！」

uniform: It won't do you any good to be in the ship without a droid to operate it.
制服: 沒有機器人操作，你待在船裡也沒用。

uniform: You don't own the ship.
制服: 這艘船不是你的。

uniform: The droid is already loaded.
制服: 機器人已經裝載上去了。

uniform: You don't have a droid to load.
制服: 你沒有機器人可以裝載。

uniform: "Hey! Wait a minute!
制服: 「嘿！等一下！

uniform: Where do you think you're
制服: 你以為你要把

uniform: goin' with my ship?!!"
制服: 我的船開去哪啊？！」

uniform: What sector shall I head for, Sir? asks the droid.
制服: 「長官，我該朝哪個星區前進？」機器人問道。

uniform: Sector HH it is. I will proceed with course entry.
制服: 「就 HH 星區。我這就輸入航線。」

uniform: Say what?
制服: 「你說什麼？」

uniform: It's just an average, everyday ladder.
制服: 就是一把很普通、隨處可見的梯子。

uniform: Seated in the cruiser you notice there are no controls here, just a button marked "LOAD". Tiny must have been serious when he said you would need a droid to fly it.
制服: 坐進巡洋艦裡，你發現這裡根本沒有操縱裝置，只有一個標著「裝載」的按鈕。看來小不點說你需要機器人才能開這艘船，還真不是在唬你。

uniform: This is actually not a bad looking ship. It appears to be a Drallion model cruiser. They have a reputation for quickness and reliability. You are surprised that someone (or something) of Tiny's caliber would be carrying it.
制服: 這艘船其實長得不差，看起來是德拉利安型巡洋艦，以速度快、可靠出名。你很意外像小不點這種等級的角色居然會賣這款船。

uniform: Sorry, you can only fly it when you buy it. And, oh by the way, there are no refunds either. Company Policy.
制服: 「抱歉，買下來才能開。喔對了，也不能退貨，公司規定。」

uniform: That act can not be performed currently.
制服: 現在做不了這件事。

uniform: That won't do any good until you're in the ship.
制服: 你還沒上船，這樣做沒有用。

uniform: Please supply coordinates.
制服: 請輸入座標。

uniform: Looking at the inside of the ship you notice there are no controls here, just a button marked "LOAD". Tiny must have been serious when he said you would need a droid to fly it.
制服: 看著船艙內部，你發現這裡根本沒有操縱裝置，只有一個標著「裝載」的按鈕。看來小不點說你需要機器人才能開這艘船，還真不是在唬你。

uniform: There is no salesman here.
制服: 這裡沒有業務員。

uniform: You can't board it because you don't own it.
制服: 這艘船不是你的，你不能上船。

uniform: This is actually not a bad looking ship. It appears to be a Drallion model cruiser. They have a reputation for quickness and reliability.
制服: 這艘船其實長得不差，看起來是德拉利安型巡洋艦，以速度快、可靠出名。

uniform: There is no droid in position to load.
制服: 沒有機器人在待命位置可以裝載。

uniform: You are at the north end of Ulence Flats. There is a building to the east.
制服: 你在尤倫斯荒原的北端，東邊有一棟建築物。

uniform: There are five buckazoids stuck in the sand behind the building.
制服: 建築物後面的沙子裡卡著五枚太空幣。

uniform: There is nothing here for you to get.
制服: 這裡沒有東西能拿。

uniform: It looks like your typical desert dwelling.
制服: 看起來就是典型的沙漠住所。

uniform: You leave a moist arch on the building's side.
制服: 你在建築物側邊留下一道濕漉漉的弧線。

uniform: You beam with pride having just written your name in the sand.
制服: 你得意洋洋，剛剛才在沙地上寫下自己的名字。

uniform: Drat! You could have done without that sudden gust of wind.
制服: 可惡！這陣風偏偏挑這時候吹，你根本用不著。

uniform: This is the exterior of Droids-B-Us. There is a door here.
制服: 這裡是「機器人量販店」的外面，這裡有一扇門。

uniform: The sign says "Droids-B-Us". That's it.
制服: 招牌上寫著『機器人量販店』，就這樣。

uniform: The droid waits outside for you.
制服: 機器人在外面等你。

uniform: We have established visual contact with a ship of Sarien origin, says the droid. "The name Deltaur is confirmed. You might consider the fact that we are in danger by being anywhere near this ship. I hope you didn't waste money on the extended warranty when you purchased me."
制服: 「我們已經目視接觸到一艘沙利安人的船艦，」機器人說。「船名確認是代爾它號。你該考慮一下，我們待在這艘船附近有多危險。希望你買我的時候沒有多花錢加保延長保固。」

uniform: I will slow our approach and stand off at a safe distance.
制服: 「我會放慢接近速度，在安全距離外停下。」

uniform: Hang on, Sir! We are headed into an asteriod field.
制服: 「抓緊了，長官！我們正要進入小行星帶。」

uniform: That was mighty close!
制服: 剛剛真的是好險！

uniform: Please remain seated and keep your hands inside while the vehicle is moving.
制服: 本載具行進中，請坐好，雙手不要伸出去。

uniform: Darn, %s1. Upon exiting the ship, you find that you have no means of maneuvering and are subject to the whims of inertia and gravity. You quickly learn the true meaning of helplessness as death has its way with you.
制服: 該死，%s1。你一離開船艙才發現自己完全沒辦法操控方向，只能任憑慣性與重力擺布。你很快就體會到什麼叫做真正的無助——因為死神馬上找上你了。

uniform: Before you lies the Sarien battle cruiser, Deltaur. An imposingly massive ship. Now you understand why the Arcada was so easily overtaken. Your first instinct is to turn the ship around and head for home. But, then you realize that unless you do something to try to stop the Sariens, there will be no home.
制服: 你眼前是沙利安人的戰鬥巡洋艦，代爾它號，一艘氣勢驚人的龐然大物。你這下終於懂阿寇達號為什麼會這麼輕易就被攻陷了。你的第一反應是把船掉頭回家，但轉念一想，如果不做點什麼阻止沙利安人，恐怕就再也沒有家可回了。

uniform: Before leaving the safety of your ship, you instruct the little droid to set a course for Xenon, where you will rendezvous later. Providing, of course, that you are successful in carrying out your mission. Once again, you are on your own.
制服: 在離開船艙的安全庇護之前，你吩咐小機器人把航線設回氙星，之後你們會在那裡會合——當然，前提是你順利完成任務。你又只能靠自己了。

uniform: You are not close enough to perform that act.
制服: 你離得不夠近，做不了這個動作。

uniform: You grasp the large handle and twist, noting the rather significant amount of pain being registered. You are extremely grateful to hear a click.
制服: 你抓住那個大把手用力一轉，痛得不輕，你很慶幸聽到「喀」的一聲。

uniform: It is already turned.
制服: 已經轉過了。

uniform: You are floating in space just outside the biggest darn spaceship you've ever seen. You see a door. Perhaps it is a way in?
制服: 你正漂浮在太空中，就在你這輩子看過最誇張的一艘太空船外面。你看到一扇門，也許是個入口？

uniform: It appears to be a standard airlock.  There is a handle in the center.
制服: 看起來是標準氣密艙，中央有一個把手。

uniform: You can't see it from here!
制服: 從這裡看不到！

uniform: That's up to you!
制服: 這就看你了！

uniform: Are you crazy? You'd make a funny looking asteroid. Keep the jetpack on!
制服: 你瘋了嗎？你會變成一顆很滑稽的小行星喔。噴射背包別脫下來！

uniform: You see a room inside the spaceship which appears to be empty.
制服: 你看到太空船裡有一個房間，看起來是空的。

uniform: You can't see into the window from where you are.
制服: 你站的位置看不進窗戶裡面。

uniform: The inhabitants of this vessel don't appear to appreciate your desire to sight-see. You have been transformed into space dust.
制服: 這艘船上的住客顯然不欣賞你到處觀光的興致，你已經被轟成太空塵埃了。

uniform: My, aren't you the clumsy one. Because of your inability to walk without falling on your face, your helmet is now riding the elevator without you. You've blown your cover. The Sariens are sure to shoot first and ask questions later.
制服: 哎呀，你還真是笨手笨腳。你連好好走路都會跌個狗吃屎，結果頭盔自己搭電梯走了，留你在這裡。你的偽裝穿幫了，沙利安人肯定會先開槍再問問題。

uniform: Your are in one of the Deltaur's many corridors.  There is an elevator here.
制服: 你在代爾它號眾多走廊的其中一條，這裡有一部電梯。

uniform: You look at the wall and admire the Sarien architecture.  They may be scum, but they build a good spaceship.
制服: 你看著牆壁，欣賞沙利安人的建築工藝。他們雖然是人渣，但船倒是造得不錯。

uniform: You see nothing special about the elevator.
制服: 這部電梯沒什麼特別的。

uniform: It isn't here. If you wanted it, you should have held onto it!
制服: 它不在這裡。想要的話，你早該把它抓緊才對！

uniform: You are in a corridor aboard the Sarien ship.
制服: 你在沙利安人船艦上的一條走廊裡。

uniform: It's already in there.
制服: 已經在裡面了。

uniform: That has no effect.
制服: 這樣做沒有效果。

uniform: You already have one.
制服: 你已經有一個了。

uniform: The guard has nothing else of any interest.
制服: 這名守衛身上沒有其他值得注意的東西。

uniform: You seem to have found a remote control device of some sort. It has only one button, labeled "ON/OFF"
制服: 你好像找到了某種遙控裝置，上面只有一個按鈕，標著『開∕關』

uniform: Not now.
制服: 現在不行。

uniform: By pressing the button, you have deactivated the force field which surroundsthe generator.
制服: 按下按鈕後，你關閉了包圍著產生器的力場。

uniform: The force field which surrounds the Star Generator prevents you from getting any closer.
制服: 包圍著星辰產生器的力場擋住你，讓你沒辦法再靠近。

uniform: That can't be done while standing here.
制服: 站在這裡沒辦法做這件事。

uniform: The gas grenade has done its job. The guard is now unconscious. Well done, %s1.
制服: 瓦斯手榴彈成功了，守衛已經昏過去了。幹得好，%s1。

uniform: The force field has been shut down.
制服: 力場已經關閉了。

uniform: It is already on.
制服: 已經是開著的了。

uniform: You are on an elevated walkway inside an enormous chamber.  Peering over the railing, you see the stolen Star Generator.
制服: 你站在一座巨大艙室裡的高架走道上，越過欄杆望去，你看到那台被偷走的星辰產生器。

uniform: You are inside an enormous chamber. Before you stands the stolen Star Generator.
制服: 你在一座巨大的艙室裡，眼前立著那台被偷走的星辰產生器。

uniform: The walkway spans across the massive chamber to another entryway.
制服: 這條走道橫跨整座巨大艙室，通往另一個入口。

uniform: The entryway leads into another room.
制服: 這個入口通往另一個房間。

uniform: There is no door here.  Are you blind?
制服: 這裡沒有門，你是瞎了嗎？

uniform: You can't see it very well from up here.
制服: 從這麼高的地方，你看不太清楚。

uniform: Before you stands the Star Generator. You find it hard to believe that this contraption could save or destroy an entire galaxy.
制服: 星辰產生器就立在你眼前。你很難相信這台機器居然能拯救、也能毀滅整個銀河系。

uniform: Don't you have anything better to do than to stand around and look at walls?
制服: 你就沒有更好的事情做，非得站在這裡看牆壁不可嗎？

uniform: He's a gonner!  You never realized how ugly these Sariens were until now.
制服: 死翹翹了！你這才發現，這些沙利安人原來這麼醜。

uniform: He appears to be dead.
制服: 他看起來死透了。

uniform: At the base of the Star Generator is a control panel of some sort.
制服: 星辰產生器底座有個像是控制面板的東西。

uniform: The force field around the generator stops you from reaching the control panel.
制服: 產生器周圍的力場擋著你，讓你碰不到控制面板。

uniform: If you started the force field from this close, you would be immediately vaporized. The universe would lose its most valuable janitor! Perhaps you should reconsider.
制服: 如果你在這麼近的地方啟動力場，會立刻被汽化掉。宇宙會因此失去最寶貴的清潔工！你可能該三思。

uniform: It is permanently attached to the floor.
制服: 它整個焊死在地板上，動不了。

uniform: Just the thought makes your toes hurt!
制服: 光用想的，你的腳趾就痛了起來！

uniform: You are too far away to see it from here.
制服: 你離得太遠，從這裡看不清楚。

uniform: The Star Generator's force field is off.
制服: 星辰產生器的力場已經關閉。

uniform: There is nothing special about it, except for the Star Generator it holds.
制服: 它沒什麼特別的，只不過裡面裝著星辰產生器。

uniform: Suddenly, the force field protecting the Star Generator disappears.
制服: 突然間，保護星辰產生器的力場消失了。

uniform: You have reactivated the force field.
制服: 你把力場重新啟動了。

uniform: Too late! The guard has already noticed you.
制服: 太遲了！守衛已經發現你了。

uniform: The guard is already dead. You have only yourself to harm.
制服: 守衛早就死了，你這樣做只會傷到自己而已。

uniform: You gather up a nice mouth full and let it fly. Unfortunately, you forgot you were wearing a helmet. The warm saliva oozes down the side of your face. You feel rather stupid.
制服: 你含了滿滿一口口水吐出去，可惜你忘了自己戴著頭盔。溫熱的口水順著臉頰流下來，你覺得自己蠢斃了。

uniform: You gather up a nice mouthful and let it fly. Fortunately, you missed the guard. Can't you find something more constructive to do, %s1?
制服: 你含了滿滿一口口水吐出去，幸好沒吐中守衛。%s1，你就不能做點正經事嗎？

uniform: You are dead! You can only restore, restart, or quit the game.
制服: 你死了！現在只能讀取存檔、重新開始，或離開遊戲。

uniform: Well, %s1, that was a smooth half-gainer into the elevator shaft.  Did you decide that you would think more clearly with your brains re-organized?
制服: 哎呀，%s1，你這一跳漂亮地翻進了電梯井裡。是覺得把腦袋重新洗牌一下，會讓你想得更清楚嗎？

uniform: That concludes your experiment involving the effects of total vacuum on the human body, %s1.
制服: 好啦，%s1，你這下總算親身做完「人體暴露在真空中會怎樣」這個實驗了。

uniform: As you lie on the floor in a smoldering, carbogelatinous heap you can't help but wonder why you bothered getting up this morning.
制服: 你倒在地上，變成一堆還冒著煙的焦黑軟泥，忍不住在想，今天早上到底幹嘛還爬起床。

uniform: You are now lying on the floor in many pieces.  Guess those beams meant business, %s1.
制服: 你現在躺在地上，被拆成好幾塊了。看來那些雷射光束不是鬧著玩的，%s1。

uniform: How about that darn artificial gravity, %s1.  Just like the real thing, huh?
制服: 這該死的人工重力還真行啊，%s1。跟真的沒兩樣吧？

uniform: You've been snatched from existence by a tentacled beast lurking beneath the grate.  You feel the painful sting of digestive fluids.
制服: 格柵下潛伏的觸手怪一把將你拖走，你就這樣從世上消失，只感受到消化液帶來一陣椎心刺骨的痛。

uniform: Due to a lack of navigation, you have exhausted the meager amount of emergency fuel without finding a safe place to land.  You are lost in space.
制服: 因為缺乏導航，你把本來就少得可憐的緊急燃料耗光，還是沒找到安全的降落地點。你就這樣，迷失在茫茫太空之中。

uniform: Luck's turn has cost you dearly. As life seeps away, you long for the simpler days aboard the Arcada.
制服: 這次運氣不在你這邊，代價可大了。生命一點一滴流逝之際，你不禁懷念起在阿寇達號上單純的日子。

uniform: You've been mowed down by a Deltaur crewthing.
制服: 你被一名代爾它號上的船員給撂倒了。

uniform: Not being a very smooth thief you have been caught and dealt with appropriately.
制服: 你這小偷做得一點都不俐落，被逮個正著，也得到了該有的下場。

uniform: Gee whiz, %s1! You could actually be a hero if you weren't so clumsy. Wise up.
制服: 唉唷，%s1！你要是沒那麼笨手笨腳，說不定還真能當英雄呢。醒醒吧。

uniform: Thank you for playing Space Quest.  Too bad you've failed miserably and doomed all your people to a horrible death at the hands of the Sariens. If you continue playing as skillfully as this, we'll never have a chance for a sequel.  Better luck next time.
制服: 感謝你遊玩《宇宙傳奇》。可惜你搞得一塌糊塗，害全人類死在沙利安人手裡，死狀淒慘。你要是繼續這樣玩下去，我們大概永遠等不到續集了。祝你下次好運。

uniform: Alas, %s1, you have failed in your attempt to save the universe from the clutches of the Sariens.
制服: 唉，%s1，你這次拯救宇宙、擺脫沙利安人魔掌的任務，失敗了。

uniform: Once again, you've demonstrated your inability to carry out a simple task like saving all of humanity. You quickly glance around the room to see if anyone saw your silly mistake. Thank you for playing Space Quest, %s1. You've been most entertaining.
制服: 你再一次證明了自己連拯救全人類這種小事都辦不到。你趕緊環顧四周，看看有沒有人目睹你這個蠢錯。感謝你遊玩《宇宙傳奇》，%s1。你真的帶給我們不少歡樂。

uniform: You hear footsteps. . .
制服: 你聽見腳步聲……

uniform: Unable to see anyone here, the alien leaves to search elsewhere.
制服: 這裡沒看到半個人影，那外星人便轉往別處搜尋去了。

uniform: As you slip away the alien decides that one of his comrades will take care of you.
制服: 趁你偷溜的時候，那外星人心想，反正有其他同伴會盯著你。

uniform: You think you hear footsteps!
制服: 你好像聽到腳步聲！

uniform: Welcome
制服: 歡迎

uniform: Time Till Detonation
制服: 距離引爆時間

uniform: Hope your life insurance is paid up
制服: 希望你有乖乖繳壽險保費

uniform: You have traveled a long way only to die by carelessly stepping to your death. What a clod!
制服: 你千里迢迢跑到這裡，卻因為一個不小心踩空活活摔死。真是個大呆瓜！

uniform: Lucky for you it was a short drop and you landed on an area of your body not sensitive to shock. You`d better be more careful in the future, %s1.
制服: 算你幸運，這次摔得不高，而且剛好摔在不太怕痛的部位。%s1，你以後最好小心一點。

uniform: Suddenly you see a large, black metal sphere falling out of the sky - a Sarien Spider Droid. Upon touching down on the planet's surface, it sprouts legs and begins its search for you. You recall from an article in Space Piston Magazine that this droid is designed to seek out organic life forms and self destruct when contact is made.
制服: 你忽然看見天空掉下一顆黑色金屬大球——是沙利安蜘蛛機器人。牠一落地就長出好幾隻腳，開始四處搜尋你的蹤跡。你想起《太空活塞雜誌》上一篇報導提過，這種機器人的設計就是專門搜尋有機生命體，一接觸到目標就會自爆。

uniform: Not many tales are told of the spider droids due to a lack of live witnesses.
制服: 關於蜘蛛機器人的傳說並不多，畢竟活下來作證的人少之又少。

uniform: You have just been blown into bite-size chunks by a Sarien spider droid.
制服: 你剛被一台沙利安蜘蛛機器人炸成一口大小的碎塊。

制服: 已選定合適行星

制服: 行星檔案

uniform: It is a loose granular material resulting from the disintegration of  the area's rocks.
制服: 這是這一帶岩石風化崩解後，形成的鬆散顆粒物質。

uniform: It is quite a unique work of nature. It might hold you.
制服: 這是一件相當獨特的自然傑作，應該撐得住你的重量。

uniform: It is a quite unique, natural formation carved out through eons by the elements. It does not appear to be accessible from here.
制服: 這是經過億萬年風化雕琢而成的獨特天然地形，看起來沒辦法從這裡過去。

uniform: The sky is a clear and cosmic purple.
制服: 天空是一片清澈的宇宙紫。

uniform: You can see the opening into a cave but cannot make out any detail inside.
制服: 你看得到一個洞穴入口，但裡面的細節看不清楚。

uniform: In the distance you see very large piles of sand.
制服: 遠處可以看見一堆堆巨大的沙丘。

uniform: You shiver at the sight of the spider droid with its spindly legs and cold metallic body. Its red scanner probes the terrain for anything that moves. Truly an icon of terror.
制服: 看到蜘蛛機器人那細長的腳和冷冰冰的金屬身軀，你不禁打了個寒顫。牠的紅色掃描器正在地形上搜尋任何會動的東西，真是恐怖的化身。

uniform: You, a mere human, are no match for this mechanical menace.
制服: 你不過是個凡人，根本不是這台機械怪物的對手。

uniform: The cliffs are sheer and dangerous.
制服: 這片峭壁又陡又危險。

uniform: Seen one rock, seen them all.
制服: 看過一顆石頭，等於看過全部。

uniform: You cannot climb the cliffs or rocks.
制服: 你爬不上這片峭壁或岩石。

uniform: Leave the rocks alone.
制服: 別去動那些石頭。

uniform: That won't help you..
制服: 那樣對你沒有幫助。

uniform: You have some truly twisted ideas.
制服: 你的想法還真是夠扭曲的。

uniform: Why would you want to do that? You got a bone to bury?
制服: 你幹嘛想做這種事？有什麼骨頭要埋喔？

uniform: You don't need to be burying anything.
制服: 你不需要埋什麼東西。

uniform: Don't be ridiculous.
制服: 別鬧了。

uniform: It's a long way down.
制服: 這裡下去可深了。

uniform: It's quite sandy down there.
制服: 下面沙子還真多。

uniform: Not far below you is a large horizontal plane which proves beneficial in maximizing the exploitation of gravity.
制服: 你下方不遠處有一大片水平地面，非常適合讓重力發揮到淋漓盡致。

uniform: This is one of the electronic barrier stations encircling Ulence Flats. Its force field keeps out anything or anyone traveling on or under ground.
制服: 這是環繞尤倫斯荒原的電子屏障站之一，它的力場能擋住任何想從地面或地底通過的人事物。

uniform: Kerona is a desolate place. The surface seems to be strewn exclusively with sand as far as the eye can see and the heat is unrelenting.
制服: 柯羅娜星是個荒涼之地。放眼望去，地表幾乎全是沙子，熱氣更是逼人到不行。

uniform: This vast silicon sea seems to stretch to infinity.
制服: 這片浩瀚的矽沙之海，看起來一望無際。

制服: 你贏了  $%v64

制服: 算你倒楣

uniform: It's Hopeless
制服: 沒救了

uniform: Eat Sand
制服: 去吃沙吧

uniform: Suck Methane
制服: 去吸甲烷吧

uniform: So Sorry
制服: 真可惜

uniform: Not A Chance
制服: 想都別想

uniform: You hear some zapping and popping.
制服: 你聽到一陣滋滋啪啪的聲響。

uniform: The green droid is quite small and nondescript. It is a prime example of the technological state of early robotics. Fairly primitive at best. It's amazing that it still functions.
制服: 這台綠色機器人個頭不大，長相也普普通通，稱得上是早期機器人技術的典型代表——說好聽點是簡陋，能動已經算奇蹟了。

uniform: The white droid is just a little shorter than you are. Its body appears to be built of some type of light composite substance. These droids were the first truly reliable flight-control systems produced, designed to pilot many different types of craft.
制服: 這台白色機器人比你矮一點點，機身看起來是某種輕質複合材料打造的。這系列機器人是史上第一批真正可靠的飛行控制系統，專門設計來駕駛各式各樣的飛行器。

uniform: The droid you spent your hard-earned buckazoids on is lying in the sand in many pieces. You begin to suspect that the little fellow may have been defective. It is damaged beyond repair.
制服: 你花了辛苦賺來的太空幣買的那台機器人，現在四分五裂地躺在沙地上。你開始懷疑這小傢伙該不會本來就有瑕疵吧，反正它已經壞得沒法修了。

uniform: The little droid doesn't seem to have anything to say.
制服: 這台小機器人好像沒什麼話要說。

uniform: Hello...(ping) I am a model QR 7 Pilot Droid. I have navigated many different kinds of ships to many different worlds (buzz, click) and have acquired much flight knowledge from my travels.
制服: 「哈囉……（叮）我是一台 QR 7 型導航機器人。我曾經駕駛過各種不同的飛船，跑遍許多不同的世界（嗡嗡、喀嚓），旅途中累積了不少飛行知識。」

uniform: I am most anxious to serve you, Sir (click). I hope you find my services satisfactory. My, but that's a smart-looking flight suit you have on.
制服: 「我非常樂意為您服務，長官（喀嚓）。希望您會滿意我的服務。哎呀，您身上這套飛行裝還真是帥氣。」

uniform: It sure feels good to be out of that stuffy metal market (click). I thought I was doomed to sit there and rust away.
制服: 「總算離開那個悶死人的金屬市集了，感覺真好（喀嚓）。我還以為自己注定要坐在那裡生鏽到老呢。」

uniform: People say I talk too much - do you think I talk too much? I don't think I talk too much (beep). I'm going to shut up now.
制服: 「大家都說我話太多——你覺得我話很多嗎？我自己是不覺得啦（嗶）。好，我現在要閉嘴了。」

uniform: You can't do that now. Try later.
制服: 你現在不能這麼做，晚點再試試看。

uniform: This is neither the time nor the place.
制服: 現在不是時候，這裡也不是地方。

uniform: Are you crazy?
制服: 你是瘋了嗎？

uniform: There is a guardian droid here roaming the corridor.
制服: 這裡的走廊上有一台守衛機器人在巡邏。

uniform: The robot droid isn't programmed for speech, only to kill.
制服: 這台機器人沒有語言功能，只被設定用來殺人。

uniform: If the robot droid could laugh, which it is not programmed to do, it would do so. Your pulseray is only effective against living opponents!
制服: 要是這台機器人會笑——雖然它根本沒被設定成會笑——牠現在大概會笑到不行。你的雷射槍對這種東西沒用，只對活生生的對手才有效！

uniform: You are welcome to try.
制服: 你倒是可以試試看。

uniform: The bomb has fallen to the floor where it has exploded harmlessly. The guard is so intent on guarding the Star Generator he doesn't even blink an eye.
制服: 炸彈掉到地上，毫無殺傷力地爆炸了。這名守衛一心只顧著看守星辰產生器，眼睛眨都沒眨一下。

uniform: You've just been disintegrated
制服: 你剛剛被瞬間分解了

uniform: %m12by contact with the robot droid.
制服: %m12原因是碰到了那台機器人。

uniform: %m6Fortunately, it recognizes you as a Sarien.
制服: %m6，幸好牠把你認成了自己人（沙利安人）。

uniform: The grenade drops to the floor releasing its poisonous gas on the unsuspecting alien. Good shot %s1!
制服: 手榴彈掉到地上，瓦斯往那毫無防備的外星人身上噴去。丟得漂亮，%s1！

uniform: Obviously, this was not the smartest thing you've done today. You have once again demonstrated that a janitor's place is not in space.
制服: 很明顯，這不是你今天做過最聰明的事。你再一次證明了，清潔工的舞台不在太空。

uniform: You're toast!
制服: 你死定了！

uniform: %m12by the Sarien's pulseray. Perhaps this will teach you not to loiter about on the Deltaur.
制服: %m12就是被沙利安人的雷射槍打中了。這下應該能教會你別在代爾它號上到處閒晃。

uniform: Geez %s1! Go take some marksmanship courses and come back and give it another try in a couple of months. OK?
制服: 唉唷 %s1！去上個幾堂射擊課吧，過幾個月再回來試一次，好嗎？

uniform: You've just been reduced to micro-particles by the alien's pulseray. You'll have to be quicker on the draw than that %s1.
制服: 你剛被那外星人的雷射槍打成微粒子了。%s1，你拔槍的速度得比這個快才行。

uniform: You are in one of the Deltaur's ventilation shafts.
制服: 你正在代爾它號的其中一條通風管道裡。

uniform: You've seen one ladder, you've seen them all.
制服: 看過一座梯子，等於看過全部。

uniform: You see nothing special.
制服: 你沒看到什麼特別的東西。

uniform: It looks as though you've been shafted, %s1.
制服: 看來你被這條通風管坑得死死的，%s1。

uniform: It is already closed.
制服: 已經關上了。

uniform: You try to use the knife to pry open the vent, but are unsuccessful.
制服: 你想用刀子撬開通風口，但沒能成功。

uniform: It is already open.
制服: 已經開著了。

uniform: You cannot pry open the grate which seems to be stuck.
制服: 這個格柵好像卡住了，你撬不開。

uniform: Your nose has just been redesigned by your ill-advised attempt to insert it into a closed vent.
制服: 你異想天開想把鼻子伸進關著的通風口，結果鼻子當場被「重新設計」了一番。

uniform: You cannot reach the grate from here.
制服: 你在這裡搆不到那個格柵。

uniform: Through the grate you can see into what appears to be the ship's laundry facilities.
制服: 透過格柵，你可以看到裡面似乎是這艘船的洗衣間。

uniform: Through the grate you can see into an empty room.
制服: 透過格柵，你看到裡面是一間空房。

uniform: Wouldn't it be a little silly to fire a gun in here?
制服: 在這裡開槍，會不會太蠢了點？

uniform: That's up to you.
制服: 這由你決定。

uniform: It looks like you jarred it loose!
制服: 看起來你把它給搖鬆了！

uniform: It is closed.
制服: 它是關著的。

uniform: It is open.
制服: 它是開著的。

uniform: You slide the trunk just beneath a wall vent.
制服: 你把箱子推到牆邊的通風口下方。

uniform: Using your Xenon Army Knife you pry the vent open.
制服: 你用氙星軍刀把通風口撬開了。

uniform: It won't do any good unless you PUSH TRUNK to the wall, so that you can CLIMB TRUNK, OPEN VENT, ENTER VENT.
制服: 這樣做沒有用，除非你先打 PUSH TRUNK 把箱子推到牆邊，這樣才能 CLIMB TRUNK、OPEN VENT、ENTER VENT。

uniform: The voices, muffled now, grow louder.
制服: 原本模糊的說話聲，逐漸變大了。

uniform: After a few minutes the trunk thuds to
制服: 幾分鐘後，箱子砰地一聲摔到

uniform: You can not enter the narrow vent wearing that jetpack.
制服: 你背著噴射背包，根本鑽不進這條窄通風口。

uniform: With the chest open that act would be highly ineffective.
制服: 箱子開著的時候，這麼做一點用都沒有！

uniform: It's just a dirty old trunk.
制服: 只是一個髒兮兮的舊箱子。

uniform: There is no trunk here.
制服: 這裡沒有箱子。

uniform: Wouldn't you look silly standing on an open trunk?
制服: 站在打開的箱子上，你不覺得自己很蠢嗎？

uniform: Where would you like to put it?
制服: 你想把它放在哪裡？

uniform: There is a jetpack in it.
制服: 裡面有一個噴射背包。

uniform: It is empty.
制服: 裡面是空的。

uniform: Just because you can fly doesn't make you Superman.
制服: 你會飛不代表你是超人。

uniform: Don't worry about it. You won't be needing it anymore. Trust me.
制服: 別擔心，你不會再需要它了。相信我。

uniform: You put the jetpack into the trunk!
制服: 你把噴射背包放進箱子裡了！

uniform: The vent is closed.
制服: 通風口是關著的。

uniform: The vent is stuck shut.
制服: 通風口卡死了，打不開。

uniform: It is too dark to do anything in here.
制服: 這裡太暗了，什麼都看不清楚。

uniform: As you exit the trunk, you notice that you have lost your jetpack.
制服: 你從箱子裡出來時，才發現噴射背包不見了。

uniform: Your alien outfit is too bulky to allow you into the vent.
制服: 你這身外星人的裝扮太笨重了，鑽不進通風口。

uniform: The trunk is too heavy to carry around.
制服: 這箱子太重了，扛不動。

uniform: You can't, its attached to the wall.
制服: 不行，它是固定在牆上的。

uniform: You should get off the trunk first.
制服: 你應該先從箱子上下來。

uniform: Leaving your jetpack lying around wouldn't be very bright. Someone might find it, and then how would you get home?
制服: 把噴射背包隨便亂丟可不是個好主意。要是被人撿走，你要怎麼回家？

uniform: The purpose of such an endeavor seems frivolous at best!
制服: 這麼做，怎麼看都只是白費力氣！

uniform: Hey bud, what's with the helmet indoors? asks the curious guard.
制服: 「嘿，老兄，室內幹嘛還戴著頭盔？」好奇的守衛問道。

uniform: Just as you begin to speak, the Sarien guard says, "How many Analexians does it take to seduce a three-eared female sillovite."
制服: 你才剛要開口，沙利安守衛就搶著說：「要幾個阿納萊克森人，才能勾引到一隻三隻耳朵的母西洛維特？」

uniform: Which way to the little boys room? you ask, hoping Sariens even do that sort of thing.
制服: 「洗手間怎麼走？」你問道，心裡盼著沙利安人好歹也會上廁所。

uniform: Is this the way to the Star Generator? you ask.
制服: 「這是通往星辰產生器的路嗎？」你問道。

uniform: Have you played King's Quest III? you ask the Guard.
制服: 「你玩過《國王密使III》嗎？」你問守衛。

uniform: Are we having fun yet? you ask the guard.
制服: 「我們現在玩得開心嗎？」你問守衛。

uniform: Gotta light? you query the guard.
制服: 「借個火？」你問守衛。

uniform: Ssshh! you exclaim, "I'm hiding from the boss." figuring you might confuse the guard.
制服: 「噓！」你低聲說：「我在躲老闆。」心想這樣或許能唬住守衛。

uniform: After a reasonable period of silence at your end, the Guard answers his own joke, "Two!!!". He does not seem unduly impressed by your lack of laughter.
制服: 你沉默了好一陣子，守衛只好自己公布笑點：「兩個！！！」他似乎對你完全笑不出來這件事，不太滿意。

uniform: The puzzled expression on the face of your new found friend confirms your worst fears.
制服: 這位新朋友臉上的困惑表情，證實了你最擔心的事。

uniform: Don't ask me, I just work here, responds the unhelpful guard.
制服: 「別問我，我只是在這裡上班的。」毫無幫助的守衛回答。

uniform: Yes responds the surprised Guard, "I just bought it last week. It was on sale for 128,000 buckazoids at Tiny's Holodisk Shop. What a bargain!!!"
制服: 「對啊，」驚訝的守衛回答，「我上禮拜才買的。在『小不點全息碟店』特價128,000枚太空幣，超划算的！！！」

uniform: This is the most fun I've had since the Hipoglopus ate my brother, responds the bored looking Sarien.
制服: 「這是自從希波格洛帕斯吃掉我弟弟以來，我玩得最開心的一次了。」一臉無聊的沙利安人回答。

uniform: Sorry, don't drink.
制服: 「抱歉，我不喝酒。」

uniform: The guard pretends not to notice you.
制服: 守衛假裝沒看到你。

uniform: Quiet! You don't want to accidentally blow your cover, do you?
制服: 小聲點！你該不會想不小心暴露身分吧？

uniform: Shouldn't you be trying to save your planet?
制服: 你不是應該去拯救你的星球嗎？

uniform: Talk, talk, talk, can't you find anything better to do?
制服: 講話講話講話，你就沒別的事好做了嗎？

uniform: The guard wrinkles his nose in disgust. "Leave me alone!" he exclaims. "You smell like the ventricular portion of a Hypoglopus!" Obviously, this guard has no taste at all.
制服: 守衛嫌惡地皺起鼻子：「別煩我！」他大喊：「你身上的味道，像極了希波格洛帕斯的心室部位！」看來這守衛真的一點品味都沒有。

uniform: The guard looks at you as though you just questioned his mothers heritage. Perhaps you should not waste time conversing with the guards.
制服: 守衛瞪著你，好像你剛剛質疑了他母親的出身。或許你不該浪費時間跟守衛們閒聊。

uniform: The guard talks back.
制服: 守衛頂了回來。

uniform: The guard describes to you in graphic detail his previous evening's exploits.
制服: 守衛鉅細靡遺地跟你描述他昨晚的豐功偉業。

uniform: The guard outlines his favorite massacre, "The Great Daventry Rout" as he called it. You ponder the meaning of this for a while.
制服: 守衛跟你大談他最愛的一場大屠殺，他稱之為「達文垂大潰敗」。你想了半天也想不透這是什麼意思。

uniform: The guard looks at you as though you look different somehow.
制服: 守衛盯著你看，好像覺得你哪裡不太一樣。

uniform: Leave me alone. I am guarding the Star Generator.
制服: 別煩我，我正在看守星辰產生器。

uniform: Kill him yourself.
制服: 你自己動手殺他吧。

uniform: As you pucker up your lips and lean close, you suddenly remember what your mother taught you about Sariens. In a rare moment of wisdom, you decide not to get anything started you're  unwilling to finish.
制服: 你正噘起嘴唇準備湊過去，忽然想起媽媽以前怎麼教你認識沙利安人。你難得清醒了一次，心想沒把握善終的事，還是別輕易開頭。

uniform: He looks to be armed and dangerous. I wouldn't mess around with him.
制服: 他看起來全副武裝又危險，我可不會想惹他。

uniform: Do you own King's Quest II? asks the nosy guard.
制服: 「你有《國王密使II》嗎？」愛管閒事的守衛問道。

uniform: Too Bad.
制服: 「真可惜。」

uniform: Great!!! responds the guard. Pondering his interest you ask yourself whether or not this guy is getting a kickback from Sierra On-Line. Later you realize this is silly, what would a Sarien do with money from Coarsegold?
制服: 「太棒了！！！」守衛回答。看他這麼感興趣，你不禁懷疑這傢伙是不是拿了Sierra On-Line的回扣。後來你才發覺自己想太多——一個沙利安人，要柯斯戈爾德的錢幹嘛？

uniform: Everyone gets their kicks in different ways. Yours is the strangest of which I am aware.
制服: 每個人尋開心的方式都不一樣。你的這種，是我看過最奇怪的一種。

uniform: You aren't near enough.
制服: 你離得不夠近。

uniform: There is no need for that here.
制服: 這裡用不著那樣做。
